source: Zotero Web API v3, exact retained documents, and the original SF88 Research dossier

project.return.import.bytes: Uint8Array of original project-delivery or complete workspace JSON

workspace.lifecycle: Every public operation is admitted and drained. Close prevents later starts, cancels active reads, and preserves original source pages. Old control UUIDs cannot affect a successor capture attempt. Failed close retains the original database writer or child controller for a retry of the same close call. Completed children are retired individually, and the inactive connection receipt is written only after the full owned workspace closes. The original Research bridge retains the same child through raced startup or close failure; the serving CLI can retry its original shutdown signal.

coverage.CAPTURED_LIBRARY: All collections/items pages plus final version probe match one library version; native totals and original keys agree.
coverage.RETAINED_DOCUMENT_SELECTION: Original imported document bytes are retained; absence is not evidence of remote deletion.
coverage.CAPTURED_PROTOCOL_EXERCISE: All selected local protocol fixture pages are captured consistently. The transport/source identity is retained and is never represented as a live Zotero library.

research.receive: previewSourceBundle + receiveSourceBundle, exact request/body digest, no new normalizer or eligibility engine
research.portable: Original exportDossier/reopenStream retain every linked Dossier revision and source blob. A receiving binding outside immutable history maps original handoff workspace/dossier IDs into the local Research directory; subsequent exports validate the inherited history prefix and include receiver edits.

credentials: Only an environment reference is saved. Web API requests use Zotero-API-Key and Zotero-API-Version headers. Credentials are never URL parameters, logs, or portable data.

projectReturns.ancestry: Exact common project record SHA256, including a prior APPLIED incoming branch; numeric revisions alone are insufficient.
projectReturns.source: Same immutable source edition/body/documents. Changed source requires original source/project review before returned changes are reconciled.
projectReturns.review: Saved full choice map and candidate. REVIEWED applies only against its exact current local hash, return revision and preview; same accepted UUID resolves its immutable native result.
projectReturns.agent: merchant_zotero_return_import retains configured full file; existing view/save/request/resume/export tools operate the same return.
projectReturns.portable: Prepared narrow delivery retains complete selected project chain, referenced edition/profile histories and source objects; whole workspace additionally retains original return/review/request and linked Research histories.
